question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS delivered_ts
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM delivered_ts) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM delivered_ts) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  month,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2016 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "2016",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "2017",
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS "2018"
FROM monthly_counts
WHERE year IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
